notes.title: Malware City Demo is Out Now! 🦠
notes.notes:
Welcome to [b]MalwareCity[/b], where the system is corrupt, the files are dangerous, and survival depends on your instincts.

We’re thrilled to announce that the [b]first playable demo[/b] of [u]MalwareCity[/u] is [b]available starting today[/b] on Steam!

[h3]This is just the beginning…[/h3]
  This first build is our entry point into the infected system.

  [b]Your feedback is critical[/b] to help us debug and enhance the experience. Please don’t hesitate to:
[list]  [*]📝 Share your impressions[/*]  [*]📸 Post your best (or weirdest) screenshots[/*]  [*]🐛 Report bugs and glitches[/*]  [*]💬 Let us know what works and what doesn't[/*][/list]

[h3]🖥️ Platform Info[/h3]
  The current demo is [b]Windows-only[/b], but Mac and Linux versions are already in the pipeline and will be arriving soon. Stay tuned!

  Thank you for helping us shape [b]MalwareCity[/b]. This world is full of corrupted code, rogue programs, and unstable data — and your input helps us keep the system (barely) running.

  [u]Welcome to the grid. See you inside the code.[/u]
